column1: # A function-valued parameter shadows the outer function for the entire body of shadow. The call in positive binds to the outer definition; a block-local integer, where present, goes out of scope before the call in scoped. The fixture does not infer which function is passed at runtime.
# clang++ -Xclang -ast-dump -fsyntax-only scope.cpp shows a DeclRefExpr to ParmVar in shadow and to Function in positive.
